buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Terms & Conditions 1. MSME agencies shall be exempted from submission of EMD as per the prev ailing Government rules. 2. The tender shall not be subject to any arbitration. 3. Conditional or incomplete tenders shall be rejected and will not be consider ed. 4. The bidder shall submit self-attested copies of the following documents alo ng with the tender: PAN Card GST Registration Certificate

HSN/SAC Code (if applicable) Mandate Form for Electronic Fund Transfer / Internet Banking Payment Non-Banning or Delisting Certificate Acceptance Certificate valid Pest Control Licence along with DMC Licence (Code-198) Local Office Address Proof 5. The bidder must have successfully completed similar nature of work during the last 03 (three) years in any PSU/Government Organization/Coal Mining Industry. Documentary evidence in support of the experience shall be encl osed. 6. The bidder shall furnish complete details/specifications of the chemicals/m aterials proposed to be used, indicating their composition/percentage alon g with certificates issued by the Manufacturer/Authorized Distributor/Deale r. 7. The bidder shall submit a certificate from the Manufacturer/Authorized Dist ributor/Dealer confirming that the chemicals proposed to be used are non-t oxic to human beings when used as per the prescribed procedure, along wi th supporting documents/invoice. 8. The bidder shall submit a valid certificate from a qualified Entomol ogist relating to mosquito/pest control treatment. 9. The bidder shall possess a valid Pest Control Licence along with DMC Licen ce (Code-198) and submit copies of the same with the bid. 10. The bidder's office shall be located within 10–15 km of Block-II Area Office so as to ensure prompt attendance. The agency shall attend service calls within one (01) hour whenever required. 11. Successful bidder will have to engage minimum 20% of the required unskilled workers from the local project affected people (PAP) of nearby villages and ID pr oof of the worker(s) should be submitted in the office of the Area Manager (Adm in), Block-II Area. 12. The work will continue irrespective of change of location/site of mentioned esta blishment. 13. Earnest money should be deposited in the form of BC/DD of any scheduled/nat ionalised bank in favour of Bharat Coking Coal Limited, payable at Dhanbad. 14. Management reserves the right to reject any or entire tender without assigning any reasons thereof whatsoever and split-up the distributed work or amount of t he tender. Cont..pa ge-02 Page -02 15. PAYMENT TERMS: The rate of Work/service (refer table I of Annexure-C)quoted per day shall be exclusive of daily meals being provided. The GSTshall be paid extra as applicable.

The legally applicable rate of Service Tax should be clearly mentioned in the commercial bid and the rate and value in the price bid. The payment shall be settled on monthly basis. Paying Authority: - Area Finance Manager, BLOCK-II AREA. 16. SUB-CONTRACT: Sub-Contract will not be allowed in part or in whole under any circumst ances. 17. BCCL reserves the right to:- i) Follow the guidelines issued or to be issued by Govt. of India from time to time for giving purchase preference for production and services to PSUs and / or ii) Place order on Govt. Undertakings/BCCL’s Ancillary units as per DPE guidelines/ Govt. Gu idelines/ BCCL Guidelines. iii) Not withstanding anything said above BCCL reserve the right to follow any guideline or i nstructions received from the government or any statutory body from time to time. iv) Reject or accept or withdraw the tender in full or part as the case may be without assign ing any reason thereof. Note: All provisions of Coal India Limited’s Purchase Manual - 2004 (read with all amendm ents) shall be applicable to this tender. 18.
